title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11553)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11553) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11553). This Indian Standard (First Revision) which is identical with ISO 4115:1 997 'Air cargo equipment — Air/land pallet nets' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Handling and Aircraft Electrical Equipment Sectional Committee and approval of the Transport Engineering Division Council. This standard was first published in 1 986 based on ISO 4115:1 980. The first revision of this standard has been undertaken with a view to bring it in line with the latest version of ISO 4115:1 997. The text of ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as an Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
